title: CoJEPA: Combining Contrastive Learning and JEPA for Global-Local Music Representations
abstract: arXiv:2608.30974v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) has shown strong performance in learning rich representations through self-supervised prediction in latent space. However, it typically relies on teacher--student architecture with an EMA to stabilise training, and can tend to yield uninformative representations. Contrastive learning is stable to train and produces strong global representations, but remains limited on local tasks by the global nature of its objective. In this work, we combine both into CoJEPA: a single shared backbone jointly trained with a JEPA objective on masked sequence tokens and a contrastive objective on the class token. The contrastive gradient provides stability, removing the need for an EMA teacher entirely, while JEPA enriches the sequence tokens via local predictions that contrastive learning alone cannot provide. translated_title: CoJEPA：结合对比学习与JEPA实现全局-局部音乐表征
translated_abstract: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）通过在潜空间中进行自监督预测来学习丰富的表征，已展现出强大的性能。然而，它通常依赖于带有指数移动平均（EMA）的教师-学生架构来稳定训练，并且可能倾向于产生缺乏信息量的表征。对比学习训练稳定并能产生强大的全局表征，但由于其目标函数的全局性质，在局部任务上仍然受限。在本工作中，我们将两者结合形成CoJEPA：一个单一共享的骨干网络，在掩码序列标记上以JEPA目标、在类标记上以对比目标进行联合训练。对比梯度提供了训练稳定性，完全消除了对EMA教师的需求，而JEPA则通过对比学习本身无法提供的局部预测来丰富序列标记。至关重要的是，骨干网络没有添加任何额外参数：同一个模型被引导学习更丰富的表征。
tldr: CoJEPA将对比学习与JEPA联合训练于单一共享骨干网络中，利用对比梯度取代EMA教师以稳定训练，同时通过JEPA的局部预测丰富序列标记，在不增加任何额外参数的情况下学习全局-局部音乐表征。
en_tdlr: CoJEPA jointly trains contrastive learning and JEPA on a single shared backbone, using contrastive gradients to eliminate the need for an EMA teacher while enriching sequence tokens through JEPA's local predictions, learning global-local music representations without any extra parameters.
